items.zh: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日，家人通常会团聚在一起吃年夜饭。
items.reference: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China, when family members usually get together to have the reunion dinner.
hints: 得分点：最重要的 / 传统节日 / 团聚 / 年夜饭
「团聚」可用 get together／reunite；「年夜饭」常说 the reunion dinner
句型：The Spring Festival is …, when family members usually …

items.zh: 中秋节当晚，人们一边赏月一边品尝月饼，寄托对亲人的思念。
items.reference: On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, people admire the full moon while eating mooncakes, expressing their longing for their relatives.
hints: 得分点：赏月 / 月饼 / 寄托对……的思念 / 亲人
「赏月」用 admire／enjoy the full moon；后半句可用现在分词 expressing … 作伴随状语
句型：…, people admire … while eating …, expressing their longing for …

items.zh: 端午节人们吃粽子、赛龙舟，以此纪念一位古代的爱国诗人。
items.reference: During the Dragon Boat Festival, people eat zongzi and hold dragon boat races in memory of an ancient patriotic poet.
hints: 得分点：粽子 / 赛龙舟 / 纪念 / 爱国诗人
「赛龙舟」用 hold dragon boat races；「纪念」可用 in memory of
句型：During …, people eat … and hold … in memory of …

items.zh: 春节期间，长辈会给晚辈发红包，寓意驱邪迎祥。
items.reference: During the Spring Festival, elders give red envelopes to the younger generation, which symbolizes driving away evil and welcoming good luck.
hints: 得分点：红包 / 晚辈 / 驱邪 / 迎祥
「红包」可用 red envelopes／red packets；「晚辈」用 the younger generation
句型：…, elders give … to …, which symbolizes …

items.zh: 元宵节人们赏花灯、猜灯谜，街头巷尾洋溢着喜庆的气氛。
items.reference: During the Lantern Festival, people admire colorful lanterns and guess lantern riddles, and the streets are filled with a festive atmosphere.
hints: 得分点：花灯 / 灯谜 / 洋溢着／充满 / 喜庆的气氛
「猜灯谜」用 guess lantern riddles；「洋溢着」可用 be filled with
句型：…, people … and …, and the streets are filled with …

items.zh: 清明时节，人们扫墓祭祖，也会外出踏青，享受春光。
items.reference: During the Qingming Festival, people sweep tombs to honor their ancestors and also go out for a spring outing to enjoy the spring scenery.
hints: 得分点：扫墓 / 祖先 / 踏青 / 春光
「扫墓」用 sweep tombs；「踏青」意译为 go out for a spring outing
句型：…, people sweep tombs to … and also go out for … to enjoy …

items.zh: 重阳节有登高和赏菊的习俗，如今也被定为敬老节。
items.reference: The Double Ninth Festival has the custom of climbing mountains and appreciating chrysanthemums, and today it is also observed as a day to respect the elderly.
hints: 得分点：登高 / 赏菊 / 被视为／定为 / 敬老
「赏菊」可用 appreciate／admire chrysanthemums；「敬老」用 respect the elderly
句型：… has the custom of …, and today it is also observed as a day to …

items.zh: 除夕夜，全家人围坐在一起包饺子，迎接新年的到来。
items.reference: On the eve of the lunar new year, the whole family sits around the table making dumplings to welcome the arrival of the new year.

keyPoints.head: the eve of the lunar new year

hints: 得分点：除夕夜 / 全家人 / 包饺子 / 迎接……的到来
「包饺子」用 make dumplings；「围坐」可用 sit around
句型：On New Year's Eve, the whole family … making dumplings to welcome …

items.zh: 春节期间燃放烟花爆竹曾是中国人辞旧迎新的重要方式。
items.reference: It used to be an important way for Chinese people to set off fireworks and firecrackers during the Spring Festival, saying goodbye to the old year and welcoming the new one.
hints: 得分点：燃放 / 烟花爆竹 / 曾经是 / 重要的方式
「燃放」用 set off；动名词作主语可用 setting off；「曾经是」用 used to be
句型：It used to be an important way for … to set off …, saying … and welcoming …

items.zh: 如今，越来越多的人选择外出旅游过春节，传统的过年方式正在改变。
items.reference: In China, a growing number of people choose to travel during the Spring Festival nowadays, and the traditional way of celebrating the new year is changing.
hints: 得分点：如今 / 越来越多的 / 选择旅游 / 传统的……方式
「越来越多的」用 a growing number of + 复数名词；「正在改变」用现在进行时
句型：In China, a growing number of people choose to … nowadays, and the traditional way of … is changing.

items.zh: 七夕节被称为中国的情人节，源自一个古老的民间传说。
items.reference: The Qixi Festival is known as the Chinese valentine's day and originates from an ancient folk legend.
hints: 得分点：被称为 / 情人节 / 源自 / 民间传说
「被称为」用 be known as；「源自」可用 originate from／come from
句型：The Qixi Festival is known as … and originates from …

items.zh: 腊八节喝腊八粥的习俗已经流传了上千年，寓意丰收与吉祥。
items.reference: The custom of eating laba porridge on the laba festival has been passed down for over a thousand years, symbolizing a good harvest and good fortune.
hints: 得分点：腊八粥 / 流传 / 上千年 / 寓意 / 丰收
「流传」用 pass down（被动 has been passed down）；「寓意」可用现在分词 symbolizing
句型：The custom of … has been passed down for …, symbolizing …

items.zh: 冬至这天，北方人习惯吃饺子，南方人则更偏爱汤圆。
items.reference: On the day of the winter solstice, people in northern China are accustomed to eating dumplings, while those in southern China prefer sweet rice balls.
hints: 得分点：冬至 / 习惯于 / 更偏爱 / 汤圆
「习惯于」用 be accustomed to／be used to；南北对比用 while 连接
句型：…, people in northern China are accustomed to …, while those in southern China prefer …

items.zh: 中国的传统节日不仅是家人团聚的时刻，也承载着丰富的文化内涵。
items.reference: Traditional Chinese festivals are not only occasions for family reunions, but also carry rich cultural meanings.
hints: 得分点：不仅 / 也／而且 / 家人团聚 / 文化内涵
「承载」可用 carry；「不仅……而且……」用 not only … but also …
句型：Traditional Chinese festivals are not only …, but also carry …

items.zh: 春节期间，各地会举办庙会，人们可以看表演、尝小吃、买年货。
items.reference: During the Spring Festival, temple fairs are held in various places, where people can watch performances, taste local snacks and buy new year goods.
hints: 得分点：庙会 / 各地 / 看表演 / 尝小吃
「举办庙会」用被动 temple fairs are held；「各地」用 in various places
句型：…, temple fairs are held in …, where people can watch …, taste … and buy …

items.zh: 中秋节象征着团圆，远在他乡的人也会抬头望月寄托思念。
items.reference: The Mid-Autumn Festival symbolizes reunion, and people far away from home will also look up at the moon to express their longing.
hints: 得分点：团圆 / 远在他乡 / 抬头望月 / 寄托思念
「远在他乡」用 far away from home；「望月」用 look up at the moon
句型：… symbolizes reunion, and people … will also look up at the moon to …

items.zh: 春节期间，无论多远，人们都会想方设法回到家乡与亲人团聚。
items.reference: During the Spring Festival, no matter how far away they are, people will try every means to return to their hometowns and reunite with their families.
hints: 得分点：无论多远 / 想方设法 / 家乡 / 与……团聚
「无论……」用 no matter how + 形容词；「想方设法」可用 try every means to
句型：…, no matter how far away they are, people will try every means to … and reunite with …

items.zh: 泼水节是傣族最盛大的节日，人们互相泼水以示祝福。
items.reference: The Water-Sprinkling Festival is the grandest festival of the Dai people, during which people splash water on each other to express blessings.
hints: 得分点：最盛大的节日 / 泼水 / 互相 / 以示祝福
「泼水」用 splash water；「互相」可用 on each other
句型：… is the grandest festival of …, during which people splash water on each other to …

items.zh: 随着时代的发展，一些传统节日的庆祝方式变得更加多样和环保。
items.reference: The ways of celebrating some traditional festivals have become more diverse and environmentally friendly with the development of the times.
hints: 得分点：随着……的发展 / 庆祝 / 更加多样 / 环保
「随着……的发展」用 with the development of；「环保」是 environmentally friendly
句型：The ways of celebrating … have become more … and … with the development of …

items.zh: 中国的节日文化越来越受到世界的关注，许多国家也会举办庆祝活动。
items.reference: Chinese festival culture has attracted increasing attention from around the world, and many countries also hold celebration activities.
hints: 得分点：越来越受到关注 / 来自世界各地 / 许多国家 / 庆祝活动
「受到关注」可用 attract attention；「举办活动」用 hold activities
句型：… has attracted increasing attention from …, and many countries also hold …
